lq.ANSWER: Self-regulation means the feeling of responsibility toward the Body for its nurturing, protection and right utilisation. Health means the Body acts according to the Self and the parts of the Body are in harmony. The programme to ensure self-regulation and health gives priority to four areas: intake and routine, labour and exercise, posture and regulated breathing, and medicine and treatment. Intake includes air, water, sunlight, food and sensory inputs. Routine includes proper rising time, sleeping time and eating time. Labour produces physical facility, while exercise supports the health of the Body. Postures and regulated breathing help regulate the internal and external organs. Medicine and treatment are required when the Body temporarily moves away from harmony. This programme helps the Self take responsibility for the Body naturally, not through fear or force.
